orders.amount: order total (demo data — no currency implied)
orders.payment_method: demo-only label (cash/card/wallet/hybrid_card_wallet/hybrid_wallet_cash) added for readability while seeding; may not exist in production data — do not rely on it, use onlinepaymentmethod + isWallet instead
orders.onlinepaymentmethod: payment method code: 1 = cash, 2 = card. For wallet-only payments this defaults to 1. For hybrid payments, the non-wallet component decides the code (card+wallet -> 2, wallet+cash -> 1)
orders.isWallet: true if a wallet was used as part of the payment (alone or combined with card/cash), false otherwise
orders.payby: breakdown of how much of `amount` was paid via each method, e.g. {"cash": 100} or {"wallet": 40, "card": 60}; values always sum to `amount`
orders.status: order status: completed, pending, or refunded (demo data)
